common.tagline: Aap ka bijli ka bill, ab aasan!

onboarding.selectLanguage: Barah-e-karam apni pasandeeda zaban muntakhib karein:
onboarding.disclaimer: Bijli Dost aik azad helper app hai aur K-Electric ya NEPRA se wabasta nahi hai. Tamam data aap ke phone par mehfooz rehta hai.

dashboard.scanCardSubtitle: Camera se tasweer lein ya gallery se chunein
dashboard.noRecentBills: Abhi tak koi bill mehfooz nahi hua
dashboard.noRecentBillsDesc: Bijli ke bill ki tafseelat samajhne ke liye pehla bill scan karein.
dashboard.noConsumptionDesc: Mahana istemal ka graph dekhne ke liye bill scan karein.
dashboard.quickHelpDesc: Zyada bill ya meter reading issue ke liye KE ke sarkari helpline numbers dekhein.

scan.title: Bill Scan Karein
scan.cameraTip: Roshni achi rakhein aur bill seedha pakrein
scan.milestoneNotice: Camera scanning aur OCR Milestone 3 mein shamil hoga.

history.title: Mehfooz Bills
history.emptyDesc: Aap ke scan kiye gaye bills yahan nazar aayenge.
history.securityNote: Tamam bills aap ke phone par encrypted database mein mehfooz hain.
history.backupNote: Tamam records isi phone par mehfooz hain. App uninstall karne se mehfooz bills khatam ho jayenge.
history.deleteConfirmBody: Ye bill is phone se hamesha ke liye hata diya jayega.
history.unsupported: Is platform par bill mehfooz karna dastiyab nahi.

complaints.title: Shikayat aur Sarkari Rabtay
complaints.keHelplineDesc: Bijli ki hangami surat-e-haal aur shikayat ke liye 24 ghantay call center
complaints.smsServiceDesc: Bill ya status ke liye apna 13 hindsay ka account number 8119 par SMS karein
complaints.checklistTitle: Call karne se pehle ye tayyar rakhein:
complaints.checklistItem2: Apne meter ki maujooda reading ki tasweer
complaints.independentNotice: Ye maloomat sirf sarif ki asaani ke liye hain.

storage.fatalBody: App ka ye version aap ke bills ka data encryption se mehfooz nahi kar sakta, is liye bill mehfooz karna band hai. Barah-e-karam app ka taaza version install karein.
storage.recoveryOrphanedBody: Is phone par pichli installation ke mehfooz bills maujood hain, lekin app uninstall hone par un ki hifazati key khatam ho gayi. Unhein kholna mumkin nahi. Aap unhein mita kar naye sire se shuru kar sakte hain.
storage.recoveryRejectedTitle: Mehfooz bills khole nahi ja sakay
storage.recoveryRejectedBody: Is phone par mehfooz bills khole nahi ja sakay. Kuch bhi delete nahi hua. Aap dobara koshish kar sakte hain ya unhein mita kar naye sire se shuru kar sakte hain.
storage.eraseConfirmBody: Is phone par tamam mehfooz bills hamesha ke liye delete ho jayenge. Isay wapis nahi kiya ja sakta.
storage.eraseFailed: Mehfooz data mitaya nahi ja saka. Barah-e-karam dobara koshish karein.

settings.title: Mera Data
settings.statusReady: Mehfooz storage: is phone par encrypted
settings.statusUnsupported: Is platform par bill mehfooz karna dastiyab nahi
settings.exportDesc: Apne bills ki copy JSON file ki soorat mein mehfooz ya share karein.
settings.exportWarningTitle: Export mein zaati maloomat shamil hain
settings.exportWarningBody: Intibah: Export file mein bagair encryption zaati maloomat (account number, raqoom aur tareekhein) shamil hoti hain. Bijli Dost se bahar mehfooz ya messaging apps par share karne ke baad ye app ki encryption se mehfooz nahi rehti.
settings.exportEmpty: Export karne ke liye koi mehfooz bill maujood nahi.
settings.clearDesc: Is phone se tamam mehfooz bills aur encryption key delete karein.
settings.clearConfirmBody: Is phone par tamam mehfooz bills hamesha ke liye delete ho jayenge. Isay wapis nahi kiya ja sakta.
settings.clearDone: Tamam mehfooz data delete kar diya gaya.
settings.devSampleNote: Encrypted saving jaanchne ke liye aik wazeh taur par jaali bill shamil karta hai. Release build mein nazar nahi aata.
